name: repository-attribution-stewardship
description: Distinguishes and aligns copyright-holder records, citation metadata, contribution credit, copy-local public notices, and bounded machine projections. Applies during repository attribution changes, fork or adaptation guidance, and cold-start attribution orientation. Legal interpretation and rights decisions remain with a named human receiver or qualified counsel.

contract.what: A repository coordination method that gives every attribution need its fitting carrier, source authority, and proportionate check.
when: Authorship, citation, contribution credit, public HTML attribution, machine-readable metadata, or adaptation lineage could be conflated.
boundaries: Exact legal text, governed identity values, and accepted notices retain source fidelity. Legal interpretation, ownership and rights determinations, `NOTICE`, CLAs, transfer, and enforcement choices stay with the named human receiver or qualified counsel. The skill records and implements a settled decision within the authority granted by the task.
contract.result: A concise carrier map and the smallest repository change that keeps identity, credit, citation, licensing, and publication roles legible.

receivingUse.job: Authorship, citation, contribution credit, public HTML attribution, machine-readable metadata, or adaptation lineage could be conflated.
receivingUse.materialResult: A concise carrier map and the smallest repository change that keeps identity, credit, citation, licensing, and publication roles legible.
receivingUse.completion: The receiving collaborator can locate the semantic source, work within its boundaries, and recognize the material result.
